name: dwe
description: Distributes the DWE agent skill — a Docker-based developer environment manager. The skill teaches AI agents how to detect a DWE project, inspect services, look up configuration via the built-in `dwe docs` subsystem, and respect the read/mutation permission boundary.

plugins.name: dwe
plugins.description: Navigator skill for DWE projects. Activates when working in a project containing `workspace.yml`. Teaches agents how to use `dwe status`, `dwe validate`, `dwe docs`, and the deploy / runtime command boundary.
